profile.name: 高效液相色谱输液泵
profile.description: 这是一种用于高效液相色谱等实验系统的高压输液泵，用于以稳定且可控的流量输送流动相。设备可设定流速、监测压力、设置压力保护限值，并可结合溶剂压缩性参数进行补偿，适用于分析化学中的连续溶剂输送与分离实验。
profile.description_en: This is a high-pressure liquid chromatography pump used to deliver mobile phase at a stable, controlled flow rate in HPLC and related laboratory systems. It supports flow-rate setting, pressure monitoring, pressure limit protection, and solvent compressibility compensation for continuous solvent delivery in analytical separations.
